title: Textual Data Bias Detection and Mitigation - An Extensible Pipeline with Experimental Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measured at the data level using Demographic Representation Scores (DR) and an LLM-based stereotype assessment framework. It is further evaluated at the model level by fine-tuning LLMs on debiased data and testing them on standard bias benchmarks (e.g., CrowS-Pairs, BBQ, RedditBias, Honest) and a custom Simplistic Occupation Completion Task (SOCT).

Evaluated at the data level by calculating Demographic Representation Scores (DR) with custom LLM-generated word lists and detecting explicit stereotypes using sociolinguistically informed LLM prompts.

Evaluated at the data level by measuring representation bias via Demographic Representation Scores (DR) across religious groups and assessing explicit stereotypes using a threshold-based linguistic indicator framework.
Evaluated briefly as a comparative baseline during the validation of the Stereotype Detection component using the StereoSet dataset.
